page.overview:
Who is Ephina Parviras?

, also known as Effie, is one of the local representatives of the Revolutionary Council of Dol-Makjar. As an NPC, she is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

She occupies the seat reserved for the orcish Horn Clan and was the first human elected to the Council from the city. Her seat represents the Dol-Makjar districts of Rozigar, Caravan Hill, The Embers, Rubblecliff, and The Fray.

Effie is a tough, wiry, but very small human woman with some silver in her teeth. She is a brass tacks, bare-knuckle, "get it done" person. Off-Balance Cooldown|7:05|Off-Balance}}

Effie is the owner and former tavern keeper at the Napping Tabby tavern. She was elected around the year 63 defending the idea that the Revolutionary Council wasn't doing enough to house people and help the poor, something that made her popular in Caravan Hill but caused the more conservative orcs of the city to feel like she was criticizing the work her predecessors had done. Effie fought for the immigrants and refugees of Dol-Makjar, but her inexperience slowly turned public sentiment against her.
